purpose: Device-scoped allowances for capture differences that are reproduced driver behaviour rather than project regressions. Each entry narrows the exemption to one view, one target, one screen region and a bounded magnitude on one named driver build. Pixels outside a region, magnitudes above a bound, or a device that does not match are gated normally.

policy.note: DEFAULT_HDR_REGRESSION_LIMITS and DEFAULT_SDR_REGRESSION_LIMITS are untouched. An allowance removes named pixels from the comparison and then fails if those pixels exceed the recorded bounds, so it can only ever be narrower than raising a limit.

residuals.attribution: Introduced by the water pass and traceable to the reflection colour target, whose own depth is bit-stable. Sporadic between otherwise identical frames.
